def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Identity_Theft_Reports.csv"
    # File has a title row then header row; skip blank/title row and use the next row as header
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=1)
    # Normalize column names
    df = df.rename(columns={
        df.columns[0]: "state",
        df.columns[1]: "theftType",
        df.columns[2]: "reports",
        df.columns[3]: "percentage",
    })
    return df

def process(stateIdentityTheftReports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = stateIdentityTheftReports.copy()

    # Keep only Alabama rows with actual theft categories (exclude header/footer/text rows)
    df = df[(df["state"] == "Alabama") & (df["theftType"].notna())]

    # Parse reports like "1,202" -> 1202
    reports = (
        df["reports"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.replace("#", "", regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df = df.assign(reportsNum=pd.to_numeric(reports, errors="coerce"))

    total = df["reportsNum"].sum(min_count=1)
    return pd.DataFrame([{"totalIdentityTheftReportersAlabama2024": int(total) if pd.notna(total) else None}])
